### Description

In this hands-on workshop, we will build and publish your own academic website from scratch, step by step and together. We will use Quarto, a modern publishing tool that lets you create websites, blogs, and more from plain text files. By the end of the session, you will have a live website you can share with the world.

## Resources

### Quarto documentation

- [Get started with Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/): Installation and basic tutorial
- [Quarto Websites](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/): Everything about creating websites with Quarto
- [Website Navigation](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-navigation.html): Navbar, sidebar, footer options
- [HTML Themes](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-themes.html): List of predefined themes
- [Theme Options & SASS Variables](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-themes.html#sass-variables): Customize colors, fonts, and spacing with SCSS
- [About Page Templates](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-about.html): Templates for personal landing pages
- [Listing Pages](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-listings.html): Blog listings, publication lists, project galleries
- [Markdown Basics](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html): Formatting text in Quarto
- [Publishing](https://quarto.org/docs/publishing/): All publishing options (GitHub Pages, Netlify, Posit Connect Cloud, ...)

### Community resources

- [Adding a blog to a Quarto website](https://samanthacsik.github.io/posts/2022-10-24-quarto-blogs/) by Sam Csik
- [Curated list of academic Quarto sites](https://drganghe.github.io/quarto-academic-site-examples.html) by Gang He

### Template

- [quarto-academic-template](https://github.com/selinaZitrone/quarto-academic-template): The template we used in the workshop
- [Publish a Quarto website on GitHub Pages](additional_material/17_quarto-website/publish-quarto-website.qmd): Step-by-step guide to publish your website on GitHub Pages
